audit_items.proof_trace: Flash loan does not affect the exchange rate because `flash_loan_withdraw` only splits `underlying_balance` without modifying `self.cash`, so `cash_plus_borrows_minus_reserves` is unchanged (confirmed by test at reserve.move:785). Oracle prices are sourced exclusively from Pyth's EMA via a registered `PriceInfoObject` whose ID is verified against the whitelisted feed, making price injection impossible; additionally, `is_obligation_safe_for_borrow` uses `get_price_with_check` which aborts if EMA and spot diverge beyond the per-asset tolerance (default 10%), blocking single-block price-spike exploitation. The hot-potato repayment constraint means flash-loaned coins deposited as collateral cannot also be used to repay the loan, eliminating the circular drain attack.
